page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin: "M. ccc. xcvi." beside the line "Id factum anno"; and a multi-line italic note "Frisia omnis ad occidentē Lavicam Alberto Bavaro dedita.." beside the line with "Staverâ". The note's first line reads "Frifia o-" and the rest "mnis ad occidente Lavica Alberto Bavaro dedita.." in the scan; it is transcribed as one note above. Doubtful: "reda-ēti" at the line end (the word is probably "redacti"); "occidentē" with the macron as seen. The "Google" watermark at the bottom right is a digitiser mark and is left out.
